title: EEG-Asymmetries Dataset
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 100 healthy adult participants collected to investigate hemispheric asymmetries related to N1 lateralization and alpha asymmetry. Recordings include an eight-minute resting state period with alternating eyes-open and eyes-closed segments, followed by four lateralized go/no-go tasks (words, faces, emotions, houses) requiring hand-specific responses to target stimuli. The dataset supports research on lateralized cognitive and perceptual processing in the EEG.
methods_description: Participants completed a resting-state recording (~8 minutes, alternating open/closed eyes in 63s blocks) followed by four tasks (words, faces, emotions, houses) presented in randomized order. Each task included a practice block and two response blocks (right-hand and left-hand responses), with stimuli presented for 1 second followed by a fixation cross (500-700ms). Each task consisted of 160 stimulus presentations total, with participants responding via spacebar press only to specific target stimuli (animal names, female faces, houses with pitched roofs).
